flaxseed: A shallow mound of brown flax / linseed seeds (Linum usitatissimum), small smooth shiny chestnut-brown flattened teardrop seeds with pointed tips, subtle natural highlights and a few separated seeds at front. Not large almonds, not rounded mustard, not pale sesame.
sunflower_seed: A shallow mound of whole sunflower seeds in shells, elongated tapered oval shells with dark charcoal and pale cream longitudinal stripes. Several separated seeds in front and two opened shells revealing pale cream kernels. No sunflower blossom, no leaves, no bowl, no salt.
